_comment: The permission grant an unattended tending pass runs under. A consuming project's tend-prs workflow merges its own gate commands over this file and hands the result to the action as `settings:`; without it the pass reads everything and writes nothing, so /kit:review-copilot reaches its decision and is denied at the act. Deny beats allow in the merged file, so a project can widen this but cannot unlock anything refused here. Nothing on a runner is interactive: this grant is the whole of what a pass may do with nobody watching, which is why it is a reviewable file rather than a flag.
